cards.name: Buizel
cards.description: It has a flotation that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.

cards.name: Floatzel
cards.description: It floats using its well-developed floation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

cards.name: Goldeen
cards.description: It swims elegantly by flittering its tail fin as if it were a dress. It has the look of a queen.

cards.name: Manaphy
cards.description: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.description: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

cards.name: Prinplup
cards.description: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.

cards.name: Seaking
cards.description: It makes its nest by hollowing out boulders in streams with its horn. It defends its eggs with its life.

cards.name: Totodile
cards.description: It has the habit of biting anything with its developed jaws. Even its Trainer needs to be careful.
